derived_cases: Strict floating tolerance equality, zero/negative/nonfinite tolerances.
Empty/trailing fields and quote-unaware split; ASCII-only trim/case rules; UTF-8 boundary errors.
One-plus integer/float parsing, unsigned versus signed NaN payload rules, numeric range and decimal underflow.
Direct binary32 decimal above midpoint 1 + 2^-24: expected next float above 1, without intermediate binary64 rounding.
Source numeric formatter thresholds and scientific spelling, native ParamValue and MetaValue list formatting.
Checked item limits, generic conversion failures, range validation and unchanged borrowed input.
native_boundaries: Option<usize> indices instead of -1/narrowed Int or iterator end.

Portable decimal parsing; no libc++-fallback hexadecimal float extension. Nonzero decimal underflow-to-zero rejected; true signed zero and representable subnormals retained. This selects the source from_chars boundary over the more lenient libc++ fallback.
UTF-8 and deterministic ASCII case conversion instead of arbitrary bytes/current C locale.
No long-double storage; ListParse/ListFormat allow explicit user extensions.
One million items/64 MiB conservative allocating-helper storage; nonallocating searches remain linear and unrestricted.
evidence: Literal expectations transcribed from pinned source; additional expectations independently follow source operations and named native checked policies. No C++ build/execution, and no expected values generated from native production.
